caption:
Most referral requests go out at the worst possible time.

By the time the invoice or review email lands, the job is old news to the customer. The moment they're happiest is the minute your tech or team finishes and says goodbye.

Try this on your next five jobs:

1. Tech or front desk sends one text within 10 minutes of job completion
2. "Glad we got this done. Know anyone else who needs it?"
3. Drop a referral link or your phone number

People read texts same-day. Emails sit in a pile for a week.

Send the ask while the good feeling is still fresh.

The free AI Follow-Up Builder can draft this exact sequence for your business.
